 The New Orleans Pelicans (4-9) could receive a much-needed boost to their frontcourt as they look to snap their five-game losing streak against the Denver Nuggets (6-4) on Saturday night at 7 p.m. ET.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Pelicans' latest injury report on Saturday afternoon lists center Yves Missi as probable with a left knee contusion and bone bruise, putting the 22-year-old on track to return after an extended absence.
 Missi last appeared in New Orleans' 120-119 loss to the Utah Jazz on Oct. 23. The second-year center played just nine minutes before exiting with the injury, finishing with six points, one rebound and one block while shooting a perfect 3-for-3 from the field.
 Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) 
 Through two appearances this season, Missi is averaging 9.5 points, 7.5 rebounds, 2.5 assists, two blocks and one steal while shooting 88.9% from the field and 75% from the free-throw line across 19.5 minutes per contest.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement His potential return comes at a critical time for a Pelicans team struggling on both ends of the floor.
 Pelicans' full injury report vs. Nuggets 
 New Orleans enters Saturday's matchup following an embarrassing 142-111 loss to the Memphis Grizzlies in Friday night's NBA Cup contest , extending its losing streak to five games.
 The Pelicans have particularly struggled defensively, allowing at least 135 points in three consecutive games , including Wednesday's 145-111 loss to the Brooklyn Nets .
 While Missi appears poised to return, New Orleans will remain without several key contributors.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Pelicans' full injury report lists:
 Yves Missi: Probable (left knee contusion/bone bruise)
 Bryce McGowens: Out (left elbow infection)
 Trey Murphy III: Out (bilateral patellar tendinopathy)
 Dejounte Murray: Out (left ankle sprain)
 Trendon Watford: Out (right ankle sprain)
 Murray's absence also comes amid uncertainty surrounding his future with the organization after the veteran guard requested a trade Friday.
 Click Here to Subscribe With Murphy and Murray sidelined, New Orleans will need additional contributions from its available rotation to compete against Denver.
 Missi's potential return would provide the Pelicans with another interior presence as they attempt to end their recent defensive struggles and secure their fifth victory of the season.
